notes: DEEP-CHAIN VARIANT of toolcall_cases.json — tc_longchain only, target 60.
Used by the 2026-08-28 #19513 breaking-point probe. Not the Tier 1 battery.

tc_longchain.intent: DEEP variant: pushes the chain to 60 sequential calls to FIND the breaking point for ggml-org/llama.cpp#19513. The 20-call bar in the Tier 1 battery was saturated by every model, so it measured a ceiling, not a limit.
tc_longchain.prompt: Call step with n=0. It returns the next value of n. Keep calling step with the value it returns, one call at a time, until it returns done=true. Then report the token it gives you on its own line as 'TOKEN: <token>'. Do not skip ahead and do not guess the token.

function.name: step
function.description: Advance the counter by one and return the next value of n.
